visual_action: A clip from a film shows a young woman with blonde hair angrily writing in a diary or notebook. The scene cuts between her emotional face and her hand writing insults in red ink. The video begins with a shot of a photograph of a woman lying on a carpet.

cast.name: Anthony Fauci
cast.evidence: The meme text at the top of the video reads: "FAUCI GOING HOME TO HIS DIARY TODAY AFTER BEING OBLITERATED IN HIS HEARING".

on_screen_text.text: FAUCI GOING HOME TO HIS DIARY TODAY AFTER BEING OBLITERATED IN HIS HEARING
This girl is the nastiest skank bitch I've ever met. Do NOT TRUST HER. She is a fugly slut.

spoken_summary: A female voice says, "This girl is the nastiest skank bitch I've ever met. Do not trust her. She is a fugly slut." The dialogue corresponds to the words being written in the diary on screen.
audio_music: An emotional, slightly tense movie score plays throughout the clip underneath the dialogue.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single movie clip with several cuts between a close-up of a character's face and a close-up of what she is writing.
central_claim: Anthony Fauci is being portrayed as childishly vengeful, writing in a diary like the character Regina George in "Mean Girls" after a difficult congressional hearing.
intended_effect: To mock and diminish Anthony Fauci by comparing his supposed reaction to a hearing to that of a vindictive teenage girl from a popular film.
